newsitem.title: UK: Perpetual shares fall on cautious statement.
newsitem.headline: Perpetual shares fall on cautious statement.

text.p: Shares in Perpetual Plc fell on Thursday after the fund managment group posted a sharp rise in yearly profits but warned that a series of potentially negative issues would be faced in the coming year.
The shares fell 102-1/2p to 22.25 stg by 1235 GMT in light trading of 50,000 shares.

Chairman Martyn Arbib said pre-tax profit leapt 46 percent to 54.4 million stg in the year ended September 30 and funds under management rose 40 percent to 6.6 billion, but said it would be "irresponsible...not to sound a note of caution."

Arbib said: "A new disclosure regime for charges, together with the introduction of open ended investment companies and single pricing will combine to put further pressure on margins, while the confidence of investors may be tested by the forthcoming election."
He said the group recognised the challenges implcit in such issues but said it was "...well placed to meet them and the long-term outlook remains encouraging."

In the short-term however "a significant improvement on results that already reflect a material advance on previous years may be difficult to achieve in the event of adverse reaction to any of these issues," Arbib said.
